title: A date minus a date is typed as a date/time

source.quote: if a subtraction operation uses a date with any other data type, DAX converts both values to dates, and the return value is also a date.
source.supports: the subtraction table gives Date/time for Date/time minus Date/time

source.quote: DATEDIFF computes the delta between two dates, using different units of measure
source.supports: the example shows INT ( EndDate - StartDate ) = 714 for these two dates

derivation: The two dates are 714 days apart. As a date/time, 714 days after the zero date December 30, 1899 is December 14, 1901.
alternative: If the engine returns the difference as a decimal number, the value is 714.0 (type double).
